g.text: Forty independent streams per cell; color is the probability of any alert during 15 post-change batches. A=1,B=1 alone shifts. Zero can reflect

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526170

g.text: inadequate subgroup counts, weak effects, or the error-control cost. Cell intervals are in the source CSV.
